title: 第一卷 第13章 是你第一卷 第14章 好我嫁
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧
content_zh:
;;
赵老四对高强的实力一清二楚。
在力量方面，他要强于高强。
现在，高强竟然敢和他硬碰硬，简直就是在找死！
但很快，赵老四脸上的笑容猛然凝固。
因为，他发现他的手竟然被高强抓住了！
完全无法动弹！
“这……这怎么可能？！”
赵老四心中震惊。
他满脸不可思议地看向高强。
高强露出一抹残忍的笑容。
“你发现了吧？现在的你在我面前，就是一个小卡拉米。”
话落，高强的手一发力。
咔嚓一声，赵老四的手骨被捏碎。
“嘶……！”
巨大的疼痛让赵老四猛吸一口凉气，额头上青筋暴起，大喊道。
“卖鱼强！你的实力怎么会变得这么强？！”
“这一切当然是叶少给的！
话说回来，我能有如此实力。
还真是多亏了你啊！

你把天字一号别墅卖给我，我把这别墅送给叶少。
叶少一眼就看出别墅有问题。
然后他提升我的实力，让我来教训你。”
赵老四闻言，心中既是震惊又是苦涩。
他在震惊叶青云竟然在这么短的时间，能让卖鱼强的实力有如此大的提升！
赵老四估计，卖鱼强的实力至少提升了一倍。
原本两人能斗个旗鼓相当。
结果，现在他被卖鱼强压着打！
完全碾压，没有任何还手之力！
赵老四心中不服。
两人实力相当，凭什么卖鱼强一步登天成为了地下世界的新王？
“赵老四，这一次你算是聪明反被聪明误了！
看在你我多年相识的份上，我不折磨你，给你一个痛快！”
高强说完，身上气血翻涌，准备一拳了结赵老四的性命。
赵老四察觉到高强的杀意，心中冷气直冒。
在这生死攸关的时刻，没有人能保持淡定！
像他这种地下大佬同样如此，他急忙开口道。
“强哥，我认输！你饶我一命！
我认你为地下世界的新王！
从此以后，我唯你马首是瞻！”

Zhao Laosi knew Gao Qiang's strength clearly.
In terms of strength, he is stronger than Gao Qiang.
Now, Gao Qiang dares to confront him head-on. He is simply looking for death!
But soon, the smile on Zhao Laosi's face suddenly solidified.
Because, he found that his hand was grabbed by Gao Qiang!
Completely unable to move!
"This...how is this possible?!"
Zhao Laosi was shocked.
He looked at Gao Qiang with disbelief on his face.
Gao Qiang showed a cruel smile.
"Have you noticed? You are just a little Karami in front of me now."
As soon as he finished speaking, Gao Qiang used his hand.
With a click, Zhao Laosi's hand bones were crushed.
"Hiss...!"
The huge pain made Zhao Laosi take a sharp breath, veins popped up on his forehead, and he shouted.
"Selling fish! How did you become so strong?!"
"Of course Mr. Ye gave all this!
Having said that, I can have such strength.
It’s really thanks to you!
You sell Tianzi No. 1 villa to me, and I will give this villa to Mr. Ye.
Young Master Ye could tell at a glance that there was something wrong with the villa.
Then he improved my strength and asked me to teach you a lesson. "
When Zhao Laosi heard this, he was shocked and bitter.
He was shocked that Ye Qingyun could make Ma Yuqiang's strength improve so much in such a short period of time!
Zhao Laosi estimated that Ma Yuqiang's strength had at least doubled.
Originally, the two of them were equally matched.
As a result, now he is being beaten by the fish seller!
Completely crushed, without any power to fight back!
Zhao Laosi was dissatisfied.
The two are equally powerful, so why did the fish seller rise to the top and become the new king of the underground world?
"Zhao Laosi, this time you were clever but you were mistaken!
For the sake of you and me having known each other for many years, I will not torture you, but give you a good time! "
After Gao Qiang finished speaking, his energy and blood surged, and he was ready to kill Zhao Laosi with one punch.
Zhao Laosi sensed Gao Qiang's murderous intention and felt cold in his heart.
At this life-and-death moment, no one can remain calm!
The same goes for underground bosses like him, he said hurriedly.
"Brother Qiang, I admit defeat! Spare my life!
I recognize you as the new king of the underworld!
From now on, I will only follow your lead! "
